intro: Backend-focused Full-Stack Engineer with about 10 years of experience designing, building, and scaling API-driven systems, SaaS platforms, and cloud-native applications.

Strong expertise in Python, TypeScript, Node.js, React, AWS, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Nginx, with experience in distributed and multi-tenant architectures, API design, cloud deployment, and performance optimization.
aboutText: Known for writing clean, maintainable backend systems and delivering reliable solutions from architecture through production.

I have a proven track record of building reliable production systems supporting 10,000+ users, including a multi-tenant internet radio platform built with Go, Python/Django, React, and Nginx supporting at least 1,000 concurrent listeners.
